units.source_text: 距离开学还有些时日，我可以继续留在镰仓，也可以选择回去，

en.t: There was still some time before classes began, so I could either stay on in Kamakura or go back,

units.source_text: 我便决定暂且待在落脚的那个旅店。

en.t: and I decided to remain for the time being at the inn where I had been staying.

units.source_text: 朋友是中国一个有钱人家的儿子，虽说不缺钱花，

en.t: My friend was the son of a wealthy family in China, and although he was not short of money,

units.source_text: 但毕竟还是个在校学生，在花销方面和我相差不大。

en.t: he was still a student after all, and his spending was not very different from mine.

units.source_text: 所以独自留下的我，也省去了重新去找廉价旅馆的麻烦。

en.t: So, left there on my own, I was spared the trouble of looking again for a cheap lodging.

units.source_text: 旅店位于镰仓的一个偏僻之处，

en.t: The inn was in a remote part of Kamakura,

units.source_text: 倘若打算去享受台球或冰激凌这类时尚的玩意儿，

en.t: and if one wanted to enjoy fashionable things like billiards or ice cream,

units.source_text: 须穿过一条很长的田间小路，坐车去还得花费二十钱。

en.t: one had to cross a long path through the fields, and even going by rickshaw cost twenty sen.

units.source_text: 不过，这一带坐落着不少私人别墅，

en.t: Even so, there were quite a few private villas scattered around the area,

units.source_text: 且离海边很近，对于喜欢海水浴的人来说，可算是占据了有利位置。

en.t: and since it was very close to the sea, it was well situated for people who liked sea bathing.
I went swimming at the beach every day.

units.source_text: 从熏得发黑的旧茅屋之间穿过去，一下到海滩，

en.t: Passing between old thatched cottages blackened by smoke and then descending to the shore,

units.source_text: 就能看见沙滩上蠕动着来避暑的男男女女，这场景不能不让我惊诧，原来这地方住着这么多城里人。

en.t: I would see men and women who had come to escape the heat moving over the sand, and the sight astonished me, as if so many city people had been living there all along.

units.source_text: 有时候，海面上竟也会像澡堂里似的，浮着一片黑压压的脑袋。

en.t: At times the surface of the sea was so crowded with dark heads that it looked almost like a public bath.

units.source_text: 我虽然孤零零一个人，但也融入了这喧闹嬉戏之中，

en.t: Although I was completely alone, I too was drawn into that noisy playfulness,

units.source_text: 或随意躺卧在沙滩上，或在水里蹦来跳去，任凭海浪拍打着膝头，倒也快活自在。

en.t: lying idly on the sand or jumping about in the water while the waves beat against my knees, and I felt quite carefree and happy.
